title: 第12章  简直是开挂啊
content_zh:
楚弛进来后，龟婆才解释道：“七少爷，那晚我有点事，临时出去了一下。等我回来的时候，所有姑娘都死了。”
楚弛叹了口气，问道：“龟婆，你觉得她们是我杀的吗？”
龟婆点了点头，又摇了摇头：“最开始，我的确是这样觉得的，毕竟他们都说你是觉醒荒古大日体的邪魔。但你活着回来后，我就不信这话了，刚才看你朝这里拜了三下，我就更加不信了。”
龟婆经营怡春院，有一二十年了。
什么变态他没见过？楚弛什么性子，她是清楚的！
楚弛，绝对是客人中，最有礼貌，最有风度的。
这也是每个姑娘，都期盼楚弛来怡春院的原因。
“谢谢你相信我。”
龟婆摇头笑了一下，随后去到门边，确定外面没人，才继续开口道。
“七少爷，现在村子里，都在传那一晚，是庞妃烟伙同一个野男人，设计刺激你，陷害你。”
楚弛点了点头，道：“这不是……”
他本来想说，这不是传言，而是真的。
但话刚刚开口，龟婆再次开口道：“但我确定，这不是传言！”
楚弛有些惊讶，甚至还有些感动，龟婆居然这么相信他？
你懂我啊！
他忍不住问道：“你怎么这么确定。”
龟婆回答道：“七少爷，那个野男人是不是长得比你还高一点，大概一米九，头发中长，男不男女不女的。我，见过那个野男人！”
楚弛眼里有光，立马问道：“你见过他？什么时候？”
“你出事的那一天中午，我去酒楼吃饭，看见了庞妃烟，那个男人就站在庞妃烟旁边。当时，还有庞老爷在现场，我以为是庞家的客人，也没多注意。
七少爷，如果他就是那个野男人，那你就要小心了！”

龟婆一脸严肃地提醒。
“小心什么？”
“那个野男人，身份不简单。当时就连庞家老爷，都对他拱手行礼，很是客气。”
楚弛眉头一挑，他一直都以为庞妃烟是随便找了一个野男人来刺激他。
但现在看来，那根本不是什么野男人，更不是临时找的。
那个长发男子，绝对是庞妃烟的相好！
只不过，庞妃烟同楚弛有婚约，婚约不解除，她绝对不可能嫁给别人。
所以，对方商量都不商量一下，直接就设下了这个计谋。
这个计谋的好处就是，即可以光明正大的杀楚弛，又对庞家没有任何负面影响。
真他妈的狠！
真他妈的绝！
就在楚弛思考的时候，龟婆再次开口道：“我好像听他们叫那个男人为，禹少爷。老婆子我，去过不少村子。如果我没猜错的话，他，是禹家村的人！”
“私家村！”
楚弛眼神一惊。
能用姓氏命名村子的，只有私家村！
私家村的地位和实力都凌驾于飞云村这样的村子之上。
私家村的村长，绝对是强人境的修为。
这也是庞庆洋很想要建村名额的原因！
要是庞家建立庞家村，官方会派人送来强体晶。
强体晶，强人境才能凝练出，可以引领体内的灵气，自动寻找强人境所需要打通的隐脉。

没有强体晶，凡人境九重的修者，除非走狗屎运，几乎是不可能突破到下一个境界的。
也就是说，只有成为私家村村长，家族的实力，才能更进一步！
只要有一位强人境出现，就不会缺强体晶，今后自然就有第二位，第三位。
“对了，七少爷，说起私家村，我忽然记起了，前段时间，我接待过一位看上去就不平凡的客人。他当时喝酒喝醉了，说什么考察，说什么建村……但我仔细问，他又不提了。”
“考察？建村？”
楚弛身体一颤！
难道，飞云村有建村的资格了？
如果是的话，楚家和庞家几十年保持的稳定关系，一定会打破！
所谓一山不容二虎，私家村，不姓楚，就姓庞。
两家，必有一家被灭！
“龟婆，谢谢你，你给我的信息，非常重要。”
有些消息，先知道和晚知道，差距如同天与地。
这么说，他必须快速将修为提升起来啊。
凡人境六层还远远不够！
他需要将修为提升到凡人境七层，八层。
只有这样，才能做到凡人境无敌！
甚至，如果庞家真同禹家村有关系，凡人境无敌，还根本不够。
他必须有资本对抗强人境修者。
不然，整个楚家都会有大危机！
如果真有建村资格，他希望飞云村，从此姓楚。

“龟婆，多谢，我先走了。什么时候怡春院重新开张，我一定来捧场。”
楚弛说着，离开了怡春院。
他现在，迫切地想要将修为提升起来。
在村口买了一匹马，楚弛快速赶往野兽山岭。
目的，只有一个，快速提升修为！
能寻到灵药最好。
如果寻不到，那就大量猎杀野兽，获取兽丹！
一夜赶路，次日天亮，楚弛抵达了最近的入口。
他没有在外围逗留，因为外围的野兽，都是实力最低的。
很快，他的视线中出现了一头一级四阶野兽。
一级野兽，对应凡人境，四阶，对应凡人境四层。
他抽出身后背着的长剑，开始猎杀。
长剑，带起一道惊人剑芒。
《七剑斩》被楚弛施展而出。
只是三剑，便轻松斩杀了一级四阶野兽长毛猪。
他快速破开长毛猪的脑袋，但很遗憾，这头长毛猪，并未给他留下兽丹。
并不是所有野兽，都会形成兽丹。
等级越低，形成兽丹的概率越低。
楚弛一路前行，杀了第十一头四阶野兽后，才得到了第一颗一级四阶兽丹。
没有迟疑，他将兽丹吃下了肚子。

他很想知道，一颗兽丹能提升他多少灵气量。
兽丹下肚，转化成为特殊且狂暴的能量。
但这股能量，被人体排斥，进入毛孔后，便消散于了天地之间了。
一枚兽丹的力量，人类只来得及吸收百分之一，甚至不到百分之一。
这，就是兽丹唯一的缺陷。
“我草，这么浪费！要是能完全吸收兽丹的力量就好了。”
楚弛咬牙暗骂。
不知道是不是他的骂声起了作用。
识海中的镇天鼎，忽然释放出了光芒。
那些汇聚于全身毛孔，正准备散去的兽丹能量，被镇天鼎的力量，给镇压住了。
这口鼎，似乎能镇压一切。
再也没有一点能量，从楚弛身体散出。
最终，所有能量都被楚弛转化，吸收。
“全部吸收了！这岂不是说，我可以百分之百吸收兽丹的力量！天啊，这简直就是作弊啊！”
楚弛当时就疯狂了。
别人，只能吸收兽丹力量的百分之一不到，而他，却是百分之百吸收！
这说明什么？
只要给他足够的野兽，给他足够的兽丹。
他的修炼速度，是别人的至少一百倍！
如果别人需要一百颗兽丹，他一颗兽丹足以。

这简直就是作弊开挂啊！
content_en:
After Chu Chi came in, Gui Po explained: "Seventh Young Master, I had something to do that night, so I went out temporarily. When I came back, all the girls were dead."
Chu Chi sighed and asked: "Gui Po, do you think I killed them?"
Turtle Woman nodded, then shook her head: "At first, I did think so. After all, they all said that you were the evil demon who awakened the ancient sun. But after you came back alive, I didn't believe it. I just saw you bowing here three times, and I didn't believe it even more."
Gui Po has been running Yichun Hospital for ten or twenty years.
What kind of pervert has he not seen? She knows what kind of temper Chu Chi is!
Chu Chi is definitely the most polite and graceful among the guests.
This is also the reason why every girl looks forward to Chu Chi coming to Yichun Courtyard.
"Thank you for believing in me."
Turtle Woman shook her head and smiled, then went to the door to make sure there was no one outside before continuing.
"Seventh Young Master, there is a rumor in the village that that night, Pang Feiyan and a wild man planned to stimulate you and frame you."
Chu Chi nodded and said: "This is not..."
He originally wanted to say that this was not a rumor, but true.
But just as she spoke, Turtle Woman spoke again: "But I'm sure this is not a rumor!"
Chu Chi was a little surprised, even a little touched. Gui Po actually believed in him so much?
You understand me!
He couldn't help but ask: "How can you be so sure?"
Turtle Woman replied: "Seventh Young Master, is that wild man a little taller than you? He is about 1.9 meters tall, with medium-long hair. He is neither male nor female. I have seen that wild man!"
There was light in Chu Chi's eyes and he immediately asked: "Have you seen him? When?"
"At noon on the day of your accident, I went to a restaurant to eat and saw Pang Feiyan. The man was standing next to Pang Feiyan. At that time, Mr. Pang was also at the scene. I thought he was a guest of the Pang family and didn't pay much attention.
Young Master Seven, if he is that wild man, then you should be careful! "
Turtle Woman reminded with a serious look.
"What are you careful about?"
"That wild man's identity is not simple. Even the master of the Pang family bowed to him and was very polite."
Chu Chi raised his eyebrows. He had always thought that Pang Feiyan had randomly found a wild man to stimulate him.
But now it seems that he is not a wild man at all, let alone someone he found temporarily.
That long-haired man is definitely Pang Feiyan’s crush!
However, Pang Feiyan was engaged to Chu Chi, and it was absolutely impossible for her to marry anyone else unless the engagement was terminated.
Therefore, the other party directly set up this strategy without even discussing it.
The advantage of this strategy is that it can kill Chu Chi openly and without any negative impact on the Pang family.
So damn cruel!
Damn awesome!
Just as Chu Chi was thinking, Gui Po spoke again: "I seem to have heard them call that man, Master Yu. I've been to many villages, old lady. If I guess correctly, he is from Yujia Village!"
"Private village!"
Chu Chi's eyes were startled.
Only private villages can be named after their surnames!
The status and strength of private villages are higher than those of villages like Feiyun Village.
The village chief of a private village is definitely a strongman.
This is why Pang Qingyang really wants the quota for village construction!
If the Pang family establishes Pangjia Village, the official will send someone to deliver body-enhancing crystals.
Strong body crystals can only be condensed in the strong person realm. They can lead the spiritual energy in the body and automatically find the hidden veins that need to be opened in the strong person realm.
Without the Strength Crystal, it would be almost impossible for cultivators at the ninth level of the mortal realm to break through to the next realm unless they were lucky.
In other words, only by becoming the head of a private village can the family's strength be further improved!
As long as a strong person appears, there will be no shortage of strong body crystals, and there will naturally be a second and third one from now on.
"By the way, Seventh Young Master, when it comes to private villages, I suddenlyThen I remembered that some time ago, I received an unusual-looking guest. He was drunk at the time and talked about inspections and village building... But I asked carefully and he stopped mentioning it. "
"Inspection? Build a village? "
Chu Chi's body trembled!
Could it be that Feiyun Village is qualified to build a village?
If so, the stable relationship that the Chu family and the Pang family have maintained for decades will definitely be broken!
As the saying goes, one mountain cannot tolerate two tigers. If a private village is not named Chu, it will be named Pang.
Of the two families, one will be destroyed!
"Gui Po, thank you, the information you gave me is very important. "
For some news, the difference between knowing it first and knowing it later is like heaven and earth.
So, he must improve his cultivation quickly.
The sixth level of the mortal realm is not enough!
He needs to improve his cultivation to the seventh or eighth level of the mortal realm.
Only in this way can we become invincible in the mortal realm!
Even if the Pang family is really related to Yujia Village, it is not enough to be invincible in the mortal realm.
He must have the capital to fight against the strongman realm cultivators.
Otherwise, the entire Chu family will be in great crisis!
If he really has the qualifications to build a village, he hopes that Feiyun Village will be named Chu from now on.
"Gui Po, thank you very much, I'll leave first. When Yichun Hospital reopens, I will definitely come to support it. "
Chu Chi said and left Yichun Courtyard.
He is now eager to improve his cultivation.
Buying a horse at the entrance of the village, Chu Chi quickly rushed to Beast Mountain.
There is only one purpose, to quickly improve your cultivation!
It's best to find the elixir.
If you can't find it, then hunt a large number of wild beasts to get the beast elixir!
After traveling all night, Chu Chi arrived at the nearest entrance at dawn the next day.
He did not stay on the periphery, because the beasts on the periphery were all the weakest.
Soon, a first- and fourth-level beast appeared in his sight.
The first-level beast corresponds to the mortal realm, and the fourth-level beast corresponds to the fourth level of the mortal realm.
He drew out the sword on his back and started hunting.
The long sword brought out an astonishing sword light.
"Seven Swords Slash" was used by Chu Chi.
With just three swords, he easily killed the first- and fourth-level beast, the shaggy pig.
He quickly broke open the long-haired pig's head, but unfortunately, the long-haired pig did not leave him with the beast elixir.
Not all beasts will form beast elixirs.
The lower the level, the lower the probability of forming a beast elixir.
Chu Chi went all the way and got the first level 4 beast pill after killing the eleventh level 4 beast.
Without hesitation, he swallowed the beast pill.
He wanted to know how much spiritual energy a beast pill could increase in him.
When the beast pill is taken down, it transforms into special and violent energy.
But this energy was rejected by the human body, and after entering the pores, it dissipated between heaven and earth.
Human beings can only absorb one percent, or even less than one percent, of the power of a beast elixir.
This is the only flaw of the beast elixir.
"What a waste! It would be great if it could completely absorb the power of the beast elixir. "
Chu Chi gritted his teeth and cursed secretly.
I don’t know if his scolding had any effect.
The Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron in the sea of consciousness suddenly released light.
The energy of the beast elixir that had gathered in the pores of his body and was about to disperse was suppressed by the power of the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron.
This cauldron seems to be able to suppress everything.
No more energy was released from Chu Chi's body.
Eventually, all the energy was transformed and absorbed by Chu Chi.
“Absorbed it all! Doesn't this mean that I can absorb 100% of the power of the beast pill! Oh my God, this is simply cheating! "
Chu Chi went crazy at that time.
Others can only absorb less than 1% of the power of the beast elixir, but he can absorb 100% of it!
What does this mean?
Just give him enough beasts and enough beast elixirs.
His cultivation speed is at least a hundred times that of others!
If someone else needs a hundred beast pills, one for him is enough.
This is simply cheating!
